title: Poorly Designed Phone Pocket!
review_text: I purchased these shorts expecting the quality and performance I’ve always associated with Lululemon, but unfortunately, this product was a huge disappointment. The liner includes secure mesh phone pockets, but they are not secure enough for running. During my first run with these shorts, my phone slipped out of the pocket, fell to the ground, and the screen broke. A phone pocket in running shorts should keep a phone securely in place while you’re moving, but this one failed to do its job!
